issues.text: Removing the 'more than one crypto provider on the classpath is a hard failure' startup guard and replacing it with order()-based selection leaves no tiebreak rule for providers with equal order — the three server-side providers (default, elytron, fips1402) all use order 200 — so what used to be a loud startup failure (e.g. accidentally shipping both crypto-default and crypto-fips1402) now silently picks one based on unstable classpath scan order.
issues.zh: 移除「多個 crypto provider 就失敗」的保護後，相同 order 的 provider 之間沒有決勝規則。

issues.text: The new abstract order() method added directly to the public CryptoProvider interface, with no default implementation, is a binary/source-incompatible change for any CryptoProvider implementation outside this repository.
issues.zh: CryptoProvider 新增的 order() 是 abstract method，會讓 repo 外的既有實作編譯與連結失敗。

issues.text: concatenatedRSToASN1DER contains two ASN1Encoder.create().write(...) calls whose return values are discarded and never used — leftover dead code from a refactor.
issues.zh: concatenatedRSToASN1DER 內有兩行結果被丟掉的 ASN1Encoder 呼叫。

issues.text: ECDSAAlgorithmTest only asserts that its own encode/decode round-trips symmetrically; the produced DER-encoded signature is never fed back to a real JDK Signature.verify(), so encoder/decoder bugs that are symmetric to each other would still pass.
issues.zh: ECDSAAlgorithmTest 只驗證自己的 round-trip，編碼結果從未交回 JDK 驗簽。

issues.text: All three ES256/ES384/ES512 test cases share the same default (256-bit) EC key pair, so the long-form DER length-encoding branch (content length > 127 bytes), which only real P-384/P-521 signatures would trigger, is never exercised.
issues.zh: 三個 ES 測試共用同一把預設 EC 金鑰，DER 長度 >127 的分支從未被執行。

issues.text: logger.debugf() is called with a plain runtime-built string as if it were a format template (should be logger.debug()), the message string is unconditionally constructed even when debug logging is disabled, and the built string has a trailing stray comma.
issues.zh: debugf 被當成 debug 使用，訊息無條件建構且尾端多一個逗號。

issues.text: The newly added hamcrest test dependency in authz/client/pom.xml is never actually used by the only test class in that module.
issues.zh: 新增的 hamcrest 測試相依沒有被用到。

issues.text: The hand-rolled ASN.1 DER decoder has no guard against a negative length (readLength() can return -1 for indefinite-length encoding), which would throw an unchecked NegativeArraySizeException rather than the declared IOException if a future caller reached it with attacker-controlled bytes.
issues.zh: 手刻的 DER decoder 沒有防負長度（readLength 可能回傳 -1）。

issues.text: getBouncyCastleProvider() indirectly determines 'this provider has no BouncyCastle' by instantiating a default KeyStore and asking for its provider, which is much harder to read than simply returning null the way the sibling WildFlyElytronProvider implementation does.
issues.zh: getBouncyCastleProvider() 用 KeyStore 迂迴取得 JDK 預設 provider。

open_questions.text: Whether CryptoProvider implementations outside this repo (notably the separately-hosted keycloak-authz-client) have already been updated to implement the new order() method and will ship in the same release.
open_questions.zh: keycloak-common 對外發佈之後，repo 外的 CryptoProvider 實作是否已經同步補上 order()，而且兩邊會在同一個 release 一起出？

open_questions.text: Whether any real-world deployment actually has both keycloak-crypto-default and keycloak-crypto-fips1402 visible to the same classloader simultaneously, which determines the actual blast radius of F-001.
open_questions.zh: 實務上真的存在 keycloak-crypto-default 與 keycloak-crypto-fips1402 同時被同一個 classloader 看到的部署嗎？
